description: This file implements a WebSocket-based Speech-to-Text (STT) service named CartesiaSTTService, specifically designed for real-time speech transcription using the Cartesia Live API. It includes configuration options, websocket connection handling, message processing, and integration with various pipecat framework components for speech recognition, metrics, and tracing.

classes.name: CartesiaLiveOptions
classes.description: Configuration data class for Cartesia live transcription parameters, including model, language, encoding, and sample rate, with methods for serialization and access.

classes.name: CartesiaSTTService
classes.description: A WebSocket-based speech-to-text service utilizing Cartesia's API, with methods for connection management, message processing, and integration with the Pipecat framework for real-time transcription.
